stories.title: Two policemen killed and one injured in Mohmand polio team attack
stories.summary:
Two police officers lost their lives and another sustained injuries when unidentified gunmen opened fire in the Dag Tamanzai area of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Mohmand district on Tuesday. According to local law enforcement, the officers were traveling to provide security duties for an ongoing anti-polio vaccination campaign. Authorities immediately initiated a search operation in the surrounding area to apprehend the attackers responsible for the violence.

Insurgents and hostile elements frequently target vaccination teams in the terrorism-affected provinces of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan to disrupt public health initiatives. A similar incident occurred in September in Balochistan's Nushki district, where two armed guards protecting a polio crew were killed in a shooting. These security threats occur during a subnational immunization drive scheduled from November 2 to November 8, which aims to reach approximately 24 million children across 97 districts.

The National Emergency Operations Centre highlights that the nationwide campaign is vital for preventing polio, a highly contagious and incurable disease capable of causing lifelong paralysis or death. Despite these risks, safe and effective vaccines have been administered successfully in 195 nations, including every Muslim-majority country. Pakistan has registered eight wild poliovirus type 1 cases this year, consisting of six in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and two in Sindh.

stories.title: Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha Granted Bail in Islamabad
stories.summary:
An anti-terrorism court in Islamabad granted bail to lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, in a police altercation case on Tuesday. Judge Abul Hasanat Zulqarnain approved the release against surety bonds of Rs5,000 each after the police submitted the case record to the court. The specific case was registered at the Kohsar police station, accusing the couple of interfering in official duties.

This legal development unfolds just a week after the couple received a 10-year prison sentence and a fine of Rs100,000 in a separate security breach case tied to an international cricket team's visit in October 2024. Furthermore, they were previously handed a 17-year sentence by a sessions court under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act concerning controversial social media posts. Although the Supreme Court suspended their sentences related to social media posts in September and granted them bail, Islamabad police immediately rearrested them outside the court.

The lawyer couple has remained in custody since their initial arrest on January 23 following a protest outside the Islamabad High Court. The latest bail decision provides temporary relief in the ongoing series of legal challenges they face regarding protests and official duties in the capital.

stories.title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Remain Steady Amid Stable Global Rates
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan stayed unchanged on Tuesday, reflecting stable trends in international markets. The All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association reported that the cost for a per tola of gold remained flat at Rs412,136. Similarly, 10-gram gold maintained its previous value, trading at Rs353,340.

This stability follows a gain of Rs4,200 on Monday that had pushed the per tola price to Rs412,136. On the global front, the international price of gold also held steady at $3,896 per ounce throughout the day.

While gold rates remained completely level, the silver market saw a downward movement during the same trading session. The price of silver dropped by Rs120, bringing its per tola rate down to Rs5,368.

Monitoring these price movements is vital for local investors, jewelers, and everyday buyers who track precious metals as a financial safeguard. Market participants closely watch both local association updates and global commodity figures to gauge short-term economic trends.

stories.title: Sri Lankan Delegation Arrives in Pakistan for Buddhist Heritage Tour
stories.summary:
A 16-member Sri Lankan delegation has arrived in Pakistan for an eight-day Pakistan Buddhist Heritage Familiarization Tour. The group includes senior government officials, archaeologists, academics, business representatives, legal professionals, and media personalities. Key members comprise Dr. E. A. Senarath Dissanayake, Professor P. D. Mandawala, Mrs. Dilrukshi Dias Wickramasinghe, and Mr. Jagath Sumathipala. The delegation is led by Mr. Deeptha Wickramaratna and coordinated by Mr. Imran Shauket under the oversight of Federal Minister Mr. Aurangzeb Khan Khichi.

The initiative aims to strengthen bilateral relations and advance cooperation in Gandhara heritage, archaeology, education, and cultural preservation. The delegation was formally welcomed in Islamabad by Federal Minister Aurangzeb Khan Khichi, National Heritage Secretary Asad Rehman Gilani, Sri Lankan High Commissioner Fred Senevirathne, and Deputy High Commissioner Christy Ruban.

A primary highlight of the opening day was a Memorandum of Understanding signed between Hazara University and Nagananda International Buddhist University. The agreement facilitates student and faculty exchanges, joint research, and heritage preservation. Dr. Shakir Ullah and Professor P. D. Mandawala signed the document in the presence of Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Ikram Ullah Khan and other officials.

The itinerary includes visits to the Islamabad Museum, Taxila, Takht-i-Bahi, Peshawar, and Swat, alongside meetings at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Additionally, Sri Lankan television presenter Chathura Alwis is documenting the journey for an eight-episode television series to broadcast in Sri Lanka, highlighting Pakistan's archaeological treasures and cultural ties.

stories.title: IHC Suspends Order Dismissing FIR Plea Over Pims Nursery Fire
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court on Tuesday suspended a Justice of the Peace's order that had dismissed an application to register an FIR regarding the Pims neonatal fire tragedy. Justice Khadim Hussain Soomro presided over the hearing of a petition filed by lawyer Riaz Hanif Rahi on behalf of The Jurists Foundation of Pakistan. The court issued notices to the federal government, the Prime Minister’s Office, and other respondents, directing authorities to submit complete records and inquiry reports.

The tragic fire occurred on August 26 at a nursery in the Mother and Child Hospital of the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, resulting in the deaths of 14 newborns. The incident sparked public outrage and allegations of gross negligence, including claims that staff were absent from a ward locked to prevent theft. On August 28, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered an inquiry against eight Pims officials for failing to address safety deficiencies in a timely manner.

During the proceedings, petitioner counsel argued that an inquiry report had established negligence but no police case had been filed yet. The Justice of the Peace had previously rejected the request because related petitions were already pending before the high court. Justice Soomro instructed the counsel to focus strictly on legal arguments regarding the lack of an FIR rather than recounting the details of the tragedy.

The Article 199 petition also requests directives for victim compensation, restrictions on government medical staff engaging in private practice, and the inclusion of specific individuals in the Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Authority governing body. Furthermore, the petition asks for ISO standards compliance, audit reports from the Auditor General, replacement of expired electrical wiring, and the reconfiguration of neonatal units so newborns remain visible to their mothers.

The court formally notified numerous bodies, including the Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Interior, Ministry of National Health Services, Pakistan Medical and Dental Council, Capital Development Authority, and the Islamabad inspector general of police, requesting their official replies ahead of the next hearing.

stories.title: Peshawar High Court Refers Detention Petitions for Larger Bench
stories.summary:
A Peshawar High Court division bench referred multiple petitions challenging the detention of PTI leaders to the chief justice on Tuesday. The cases involve non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and other party members. Afridi has remained out of public view since governor's rule and an emergency were imposed in KP on October 11, with a federal minister later confirming his preventive custody.

The petitions also address the alleged disappearance of KP Assembly Speaker Babar Saleem Swati, MNAs Junaid Akbar and Dr. Amjid Ali, provincial minister Amjid Ali Khan, MPAs Ikramullah and Aurangzeb Khan, and former Gilgit-Baltistan chief minister Mohammad Khalid Khursheed. Mohammad Aamir, Afridi's brother, filed one petition alleging Afridi was abducted from Chief Minister House on the night the emergency was declared.

During the hearing, Justice Syed Arshad Ali noted the absence of required replies from the KP government and senior police officials despite previous court directives. KP Advocate General Sanaullah Khan requested three more days to submit responses, citing pending information from the provincial home department and law enforcement. Counsel Bashir Vazir argued that the PHC has the constitutional authority to order the production of the missing leaders and cited an assembly immunity law prohibiting such arrests of members and the speaker.

Addressing the advocate general's claims regarding numerous detentions under the Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, the bench observed that respondents consistently failed to submit requested reports and clarified that the current cases are not MPO matters. Emphasizing the gravity of a missing provincial chief minister, Justice Ali referred the matter to the chief justice to constitute a larger bench, a request also supported by the advocate general.

stories.title: مافوق الفطرت تجربات کی سائنسی وجوہات: نیند، نفسیات اور ماحول کا کردار
stories.summary:
انسانی تاریخ میں بھوتوں اور ماورائی مخلوقات کی داستانیں عام رہی ہیں، اور آج بھی بہت سے لوگ ایسے واقعات سے گزرتے ہیں جنہیں وہ مافوق الفطرت سمجھتے ہیں۔ یونیورسٹی آف ویسٹ جارجیا کی ماہرِ نفسیات پروفیسر کرسٹین سممنڈز مور کے مطابق، یہ تجربات لوگوں کے لیے ذاتی طور پر بالکل حقیقی ہوتے ہیں اور ان کی زندگیوں پر گہرے اثرات مرتب کر سکتے ہیں، لیکن اس کا مطلب یہ نہیں کہ ان کی وجہ لازماً کوئی مافوق الفطرت قوت ہوتی ہے۔

ماہرین کے مطابق اس کی ایک بڑی وجہ نیند اور جاگنے کے درمیان کی کیفیت ہے جسے ہائپناگوگک سٹیٹ کہا جاتا ہے، جس میں انسان کے لیے اپنے خیالات اور باہر ہونے والی چیزوں میں فرق کرنا مشکل ہو جاتا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ سلیپ پیرالسس بھی اس کی ایک وجہ ہے، جو سنہ 2011 کی ایک تحقیق کے مطابق عام آبادی کے 7.6 فیصد افراد کو زندگی میں کبھی نہ کبھی پیش آ چکا ہے۔ گولڈ سمتھز یونیورسٹی کے پروفیسر کرس فرنچ کا کہنا ہے کہ اس کیفیت میں جسم تو جاگ جاتا ہے لیکن دماغ سو رہا ہوتا ہے، جس سے کمرے میں کسی اور کی موجودگی کا احساس ہوتا ہے۔

دماغ کی جانب سے بے ترتیب چیزوں میں کوئی شکل یا نمونہ تلاش کرنے کی صلاحیت کو پیراڈولیا کہا جاتا ہے، جو ذہنی دباؤ کے دوران ایسے تجربات کا سبب بنتی ہے۔ کینیڈا کی میک ایون یونیورسٹی کے پروفیسر روڈنی شملٹز کے مطابق، اکیلے ہونے پر ڈسوسی ایشن نامی نفسیاتی کیفیت کی وجہ سے بھی انسان کو اپنے ہی وجود کا کوئی حصہ کسی دوسرے شخص کی صورت میں محسوس ہو سکتا ہے۔ کچھ تحقیقات میں مافوق الفطرت دعوؤں اور ٹرانس لِمینیلٹی نامی نفسیاتی خصوصیت کے درمیان بھی تعلق پایا گیا ہے۔

نفسیاتی وجوہات کے علاوہ ماحولیاتی عوامل بھی اہم کردار ادا کرتے ہیں۔ پروفیسر کرس فرنچ بتاتے ہیں کہ کم روشنی والی جگہیں یا اونچی چھت والے کمرے بے چینی پیدا کرتے ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ بیس ہرٹز سے کم فریکوئنسی والی آوازیں جنہیں انفراساؤنڈ کہا جاتا ہے، انسانوں میں ذہنی دباؤ اور چڑچڑاپن پیدا کر سکتی ہیں، حالانکہ ماہرین کے درمیان اس کے اور مافوق الفطرت تجربات کے تعلق پر اختلاف موجود ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Against US Dollar in Inter-Bank Market
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee experienced a slight increase against the US dollar within the inter-bank market on Tuesday, concluding the session at 276.71. This marked a minor gain of Re0.01 compared to the previous day's close of 276.72 against the greenback.

On a global scale, the US dollar fluctuated alongside energy prices on Tuesday. Hopes for a diplomatic resolution between the United States and Iran contributed to falling energy costs, which helped alleviate inflation concerns and pushed longer-dated US Treasury yields downward. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield remained stable at 4.9145%, while the 30-year bond yield stayed flat at 5.2868%, both having previously dipped to nearly two-month lows. Meanwhile, the dollar index traded slightly lower at 101.76 after reaching a one-month low on Monday.

Despite these movements, ongoing risk aversion driven by an artificial intelligence-fueled stock market slump and looming tensions surrounding US midterm elections provided continued support for the dollar as a safe-haven asset. The euro rose slightly to $1.1185 due to the softer dollar, while the Japanese yen remained unchanged at 157.915 per dollar amidst a local holiday.

Oil prices saw a modest increase on Tuesday following reports that the United States struck Iran’s Qeshm Island. This development heightened fears of an escalation in the eight-month conflict and potential long-term disruptions to Middle East energy supplies. US West Texas Intermediate crude increased by 20 cents, or 0.21%, to reach $96.66 per barrel, and Brent crude futures rose by 3 cents, or 0.03%, to $104.8 per barrel by 0355 GMT. These gains followed a more than 7% drop in both benchmark prices on Monday, which had been driven by optimism from talks between Iranian and Qatari officials aimed at ending the US-Israeli war with Iran.

stories.title: Binance Reports Normalised Outflows While North Korea Rejects Hacking Allegations
stories.summary:
Asset outflows from Binance have returned to normal, with the cryptocurrency exchange maintaining very strong financial health, according to its co-CEO. This update follows a massive $6.3 billion crypto heist on the platform last week that initially triggered net customer withdrawals totaling $4.72 billion by Monday. Speaking at a Hong Kong Fintech Week event on Tuesday, Richard Teng noted that despite an initial spike in the first 24 hours, withdrawals have stabilised and 95 per cent of the affected tokens have been replenished. Binance also reported on X that hourly deposits are now exceeding withdrawals, reflecting improving user activity.

The Federal Bureau of Investigation stated over the weekend that North Korea was behind the theft of over $6bn in crypto assets. In response, Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the US claims as absurd rhetoric and a grave political provocation, according to the state news agency KCNA. She stated that the allegations demonstrate Washington's ongoing hostility toward Pyongyang and noted that North Korea has issues to reconsider regarding US hostility. North Korea has consistently denied any involvement in cryptocurrency theft or other cybercrimes.

Analysts in Seoul suggest Pyongyang's swift response stems from concerns that the accusations could lead to stricter international efforts to disrupt illicit revenue streams used to fund its weapons programs. Cybersecurity firms note that North Korea relies heavily on crypto thefts to finance its nuclear and missile development, with Elliptic estimating stolen funds at $7.6bn this year and Chainalysis reporting that North Korea was linked to 89% of crypto hack losses in 2026. The estimated scale of the recent Binance theft is substantial compared to North Korea's broader economy, which South Korea's central bank estimated at 35.09 billion dollars in 2025.

In an effort to stem outflows and attract new users, Binance launched a community appreciation campaign on Monday running through November 21, offering fee rebates, trading volume rewards, and annual percentage rates of up to 10% on specific yield products. Having frozen withdrawals for over two days, the platform reopened withdrawals for additional assets on Tuesday. Since resuming withdrawals, Binance has recorded net outflows of roughly 3% of its total platform assets. Industry analysts noted that the relatively contained price reaction and modest outflows indicate market resilience, with investors separating exchange security issues from the broader Bitcoin network.

stories.title: Fatal Stampede at TikToker Mr. Patlu's Wedding Raised in Punjab Assembly
stories.summary:
A fatal stampede that occurred during the wedding ceremony of TikToker Mr. Patlu has become a point of discussion in the Punjab Assembly after an opposition member submitted a Calling Attention Notice. Provincial Assembly Opposition Member Nadeem Qureshi filed the notice following the tragic incident in Sialkot, which resulted in one death and 18 injuries. A formal case regarding the incident has been registered at the Motra Police Station in Sialkot.

The Calling Attention Notice addresses key questions regarding administrative permissions and safety protocols for the event. The MPA questioned whether the local administration formally authorized the large gathering at the Sialkot Daska Stadium. Furthermore, he inquired about the specific security arrangements and Standard Operating Procedures implemented for the celebration, alongside the total number of arrests made in the aftermath of the tragedy. He urged the police to provide a comprehensive investigation report and brief the assembly on all actions taken so far.

Prior to the assembly session, Patlo addressed the incident in a tearful video posted on his TikTok account, asking for justice. He defended himself by stating that he had obtained proper official permission and a No Objection Certificate for the gathering. He expressed grief over the accident involving the public, questioned his personal liability for the crowd's actions, and stated that he was willing to present himself to authorities if his brothers filed a First Information Report against him, while noting his physical limitations.

The tragedy unfolded at a stadium located on Daska road during Patlo's mehndi ceremony. According to reports, thousands of individuals traveled from distant areas to attend the event. A large crowd had gathered outside the venue ahead of a scheduled prize draw. The situation quickly escalated into chaos and a stampede as soon as the gates were opened, leaving one person dead and nearly two dozen others injured.

stories.title: French Judges Open War Crimes Investigation into Israeli Strike in Lebanon
stories.summary:
France has initiated a judicial investigation into a war crimes complaint concerning an Israeli airstrike on a residential building in Lebanon in 2024, according to lawyer Clemence Bectarte. The legal action was launched by French-Lebanese artist Ali Cherri, whose parents were killed in the Beirut bombardment, alongside the International Federation for Human Rights. Bectarte noted that the Paris Judicial Court's crimes against humanity unit has appointed two investigating judges to handle the case, describing the move as a legal first.

Ali Cherri explained that he has spent nearly two years fighting to ensure that the Israeli bombing, which claimed the lives of his parents and five other civilians, does not go unpunished. He expressed hope that the investigation will help dismantle the impunity enjoyed by Israeli officials responsible for attacks against civilians in Lebanon and Palestine, emphasizing that the tragedy involving his parents is not an isolated incident. The Agence France-Presse has contacted the Israeli military for comment regarding the proceedings.

Hostilities between Israel and the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah erupted following Israeli military operations in the Gaza Strip. The conflict escalated into open warfare in September 2024, resulting in more than 4,000 deaths in Lebanon and forcing over a million residents to flee their homes.

stories.title: Pakistan Footwear Exports Rise During First Quarter of Fiscal Year
stories.summary:
Pakistan experienced a notable increase in footwear exports during the first quarter of the 2026-27 fiscal year compared to the same period in the previous year. According to figures released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, total footwear shipments reached US$ 52.226 million between July and September 2026, showing a growth of 14.59 per cent over the US$ 45.577 million recorded during July-September 2025.

Specific categories within the sector saw varying performance during the quarter under review. Leather footwear exports climbed by 18.82 per cent, moving from US$ 35.948 million to US$ 42.712 million. Similarly, canvas footwear exports surged by 83.28 per cent, rising from US$ 0.441 million to US$ 0.808 million. In contrast, exports of all other footwear categories experienced a decline of 5.25 per cent, dropping to US$ 8.706 million from US$ 9.188 million.

On a monthly basis, September 2026 performance demonstrated strong year-on-year growth of 58.83 per cent, with shipments totaling $19.017 million compared to $11.973 million in September 2025. Month-on-month figures for September 2026 also showed an 18.72 per cent increase compared to August 2026 exports of $16.018 million.

Separately, in Islamabad on November 3, 2026, a 16-member Sri Lankan delegation arrived in Pakistan for an eight-day familiarization tour. The delegation includes senior government officials, Buddhist community leaders, archaeologists, academics, business representatives, legal professionals, and media personalities to foster bilateral relations and cooperation.

stories.title: Federal Minister Praises Pakistani Farmers for Record Wheat Yield
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for National Food Security and Research, Rana Tanveer Hussain, recently praised agricultural workers across Pakistan for achieving a record wheat yield of 70 maunds per acre. Speaking at an event organized by Fatima Fertilizer called "Sarsabz Ki Jeet," the minister highlighted that enhanced crop production is a direct result of quality seeds, balanced fertilizer usage, and modern farming techniques. He noted that higher productivity will reinforce national food security and generate foreign exchange through exports.

Hussain acknowledged the contributions of provincial leaders, including Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif and Provincial Minister for Agriculture Syed Muhammad Ashiq Hussain Kirmani, alongside the Punjab Agriculture Department. He also commended Fatima Fertilizer for supporting farmer training and promoting balanced fertilizers, noting that winning farmers predominantly utilized Sarsabz Nitrophos and CAN fertilizers.

Outlining government priorities, the minister stated that current policies aim to reduce production costs, raise farm incomes, and boost per-acre output. Key initiatives include a comprehensive National Wheat Policy proposing a support price of Rs. 4,500 per maund, strategic reserves of up to six million metric tonnes, and the approval of the National Seed and Agricultural Biotechnology policies. Additionally, institutions like the Pakistan Agricultural Research Council are advancing research via speed breeding and smart greenhouses.

Emphasizing that farmers are the core guardians of national food security, Hussain called for deeper collaboration between the government, private sector, and research bodies. The event underscored the importance of recognizing high-performing farmers to encourage continued agricultural innovation and productivity throughout the country.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Investor Base Surges to Record High
stories.summary:
The investor base of the Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced a substantial surge, growing by 56 per cent year-on-year to reach a record 681,965 accounts. Data published by the Finance Ministry highlighted that October saw the highest monthly addition of new accounts on record, with 25,747 investors joining during the month alone.

According to the ministry, this expansion demonstrates a major transformation and growing trust in the country's capital markets, driven largely by strong retail participation. Between January and October 2026, the exchange added 218,894 net new investors, surpassing the combined additions of the previous four full years.

Demographic data indicates that the influx of market participants is heavily youth-driven, with Gen Z and Millennials accounting for 85 per cent of all new investors. This rapid growth follows earlier milestones, including crossing the 600,000 investor threshold in August 2026.

stories.title: India Faces Rising Food Inflation Due to Weak Monsoon and El Nino
stories.summary:
Millions of farmers across southern and western India are struggling with severe water shortages and poor soil moisture after receiving below-average monsoon rains. In Jalna district, Maharashtra, local weather offices reported about 48 percent less rain than average, preventing farmers like 78-year-old Amarsingh Gushinge from planting vital winter crops such as wheat and chickpeas. These unfavorable planting conditions raise the risk of stunted crop growth and lower yields.

Lower agricultural output threatens to worsen food inflation, which is already climbing alongside a severe El Nino phenomenon. Prices for staples like sugar, pulses, wheat, rice, onions, milk, and poultry are increasing. Devendra Pant, chief economist at India Ratings and Research, warned that food inflation could reach approximately 10 percent in the October-December quarter. This surge follows September's annual retail food inflation rate of 7.74 percent, which pushed headline inflation close to the Reserve Bank of India’s upper tolerance limit of 6 percent.

Economists note that protein items have been primary drivers of these price pressures. Animal protein and spices accounted for nearly half of the 200-basis point rise in food inflation between March and August, fueled by higher energy, transport, packaging, and feed costs. Furthermore, sugar output is projected to fall short of domestic consumption for a second consecutive year, leading the government to authorize duty-free imports of 1 million metric tons despite higher global rates.

To counter these broader price pressures, analysts expect the central bank to implement additional interest rate hikes of 50 to 75 basis points. Meanwhile, policymakers in the second half of the financial year face the complex challenge of sustaining economic activity while maintaining price stability amid elevated crude oil prices and an uncertain outlook for winter crops.

stories.title: پشاور ہائیکورٹ: سہیل آفریدی اور بابر سلیم سواتی کی بازیابی پر لارجر بینچ کی تجویز
stories.summary:
پشاور ہائیکورٹ نے سابق وزیراعلیٰ خیبرپختونخوا سہیل آفریدی اور صوبائی اسمبلی کے اسپیکر بابر سلیم سواتی کی بازیابی کے کیس کی سماعت کے دوران معاملہ چیف جسٹس کے سامنے رکھنے کا حکم دیتے ہوئے لارجر بینچ قائم کرنے کی تجویز دی ہے۔ عدالت نے اس معاملے پر ایڈووکیٹ جنرل کی سرزنش بھی کی۔

سماعت کے دوران جسٹس ارشد علی نے ایڈووکیٹ جنرل سے مکالمہ کرتے ہوئے استفسار کیا کہ دس دن ملنے کے باوجود عدالتی حکم پر جواب جمع کیوں نہیں کرایا گیا۔ جواب میں ایڈووکیٹ جنرل نے مؤقف اپنایا کہ انہیں رپورٹ آج ہی ملی ہے اور اس کے لیے تین دن کا وقت درکار ہے کیونکہ پولیس، قانون نافذ کرنے والی ایجنسیوں اور ڈی سیز سے بھی رپورٹس طلب کی گئی ہیں۔

ایڈووکیٹ جنرل نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ اس سے قبل بھی سیکڑوں تین ایم پی او کیسز ایسے جمع ہوئے ہیں جن میں ان سے رائے نہیں لی گئی۔ اس پر جسٹس ارشد علی نے واضح کیا کہ اگر یہی رویہ رہا تو اس کیس کو لارجر بینچ کے پاس بھیج دیا جائے گا، جس پر ایڈووکیٹ جنرل نے بھی لارجر بینچ بنانے کی استدعا کی۔

خیبرپختونخوا کی مجموعی صورتحال کے پیش نظر وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے بھی ایک جائزہ اجلاس طلب کر رکھا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ عدالت کا یہ فیصلہ مذکورہ دونوں اہم سیاسی شخصیات کی بازیابی کے مقدمے میں قانونی کارروائی اور حکومتی اداروں کی رپورٹنگ کے تناظر میں انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

stories.title: آمنہ بلوچ نے ترکیہ میں پاکستان کی پہلی خاتون سفیر کی حیثیت سے عہدہ سنبھال لیا
stories.summary:
تین دہائیوں سے زائد کا سفارتی تجربہ رکھنے والی سینئر سفارت کار اور ستارۂ امتیاز یافتہ آمنہ بلوچ نے ترکیہ میں پاکستان کی نامزد سفیر کی حیثیت سے باضابطہ طور پر اپنی ذمے داریاں سنبھال لی ہیں۔ یہ پہلا موقع ہے کہ انقرہ میں کوئی خاتون پاکستان کی نمائندگی کر رہی ہے، جسے ملکی تاریخ میں ایک اہم سفارتی سنگِ میل قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

آمنہ بلوچ نے 1991 میں پاکستان کی فارن سروس میں شمولیت اختیار کی تھی اور تاریخ و بزنس ایڈمنسٹریشن میں ماسٹرز ڈگریاں رکھتی ہیں۔ اپنے طویل کیریئر کے دوران وہ کوپن ہیگن، کولمبو، چینگڈو، ملائیشیا (ہائی کمشنر) اور بیلجیئم (سفیر) میں خدمات انجام دے چکی ہیں۔ ان کی شاندار کارکردگی کے اعتراف میں انہیں پاکستان کی 33 ویں سیکریٹری خارجہ مقرر کیا گیا تھا جہاں انہوں نے دو سال تک وزارت خارجہ کی سربراہی کی، اور وزیرِاعظم پاکستان نے یومِ آزادی 2025 کے موقع پر انہیں ستارۂ امتیاز سے نوازا۔

ذمے داریاں سنبھالنے کے بعد آمنہ بلوچ نے اس اعتماد پر وزیرِاعظم پاکستان کا شکریہ ادا کرتے ہوئے عزم ظاہر کیا کہ وہ پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے مابین دیرینہ دوستانہ تعلقات اور کثیرالجہتی تعاون کو مزید مضبوط کرنے کے لیے پوری دیانت داری سے کام کریں گی۔ دونوں ممالک کی مشترکہ تاریخ اور باہمی اعتماد کو وسعت دینا ان کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے۔

صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری اور نائب وزیرِاعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار نے آمنہ بلوچ کو نئی ذمے داریاں سنبھالنے پر مبارک باد دی ہے۔ صدر زرداری نے امید ظاہر کی ہے کہ ان کی تعیناتی سے پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے برادرانہ تعلقات اور شراکت داری کو مزید نئی جہتیں ملیں گی۔

stories.title: مولوی فضل الرحمٰن کو دو سو فیصد دوست سمجھتا ہوں: وفاقی وزیرِ دفاع خواجہ آصف
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیرِ دفاع خواجہ آصف نے جمیعت علمائے اسلام (جے یو آئی) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی جانب سے دوست قرار دیئے جانے کے بیان پر ردِ عمل دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ وہ مولانا کو دو سو فیصد اپنا دوست سمجھتے ہیں اور دونوں کے درمیان گہرے دوستانہ تعلقات ہیں۔

یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب گزشتہ روز مولانا فضل الرحمٰن نے خواجہ آصف کو محترم دوست اور بھائی قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا تھا کہ انہوں نے صرف تھوڑی سی گدگدی کی تھی اور اگلے روز غصہ کرنے والے کو دیر سے یاد آنے والا مکا خود کو مارنا چاہیے۔ مولانا کا یہ بھی کہنا تھا کہ قوم کو اعتماد میں لینے کا واحد پلیٹ فارم صرف پارلیمنٹ ہے اور کچھ لوگ اپنا قد بڑھانے کے لیے ان پر تنقید کرتے ہیں۔

خواجہ آصف نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کے ساتھ ان کا تعلق بہت پرانا ہے اور سیاست کبھی بھی باہمی تعلقات کو خراب نہیں کرتی۔ ان کے اس بیان سے دونوں سیاستدانوں کے مابین خوشگوار اور دیرینہ تعلقات کی عکاسی ہوتی ہے۔

یہ سیاسی بیان بازی اور مصالحانہ ردِ عمل ملک کی موجودہ سیاسی صورتحال کے تناظر میں سامنے آیا ہے، جہاں اپوزیشن اور حکومت کے درمیان مختلف امور پر بحث جاری ہے لیکن بعض رہنماؤں کے ذاتی تعلقات سیاسی اختلافات سے بالاتر نظر آتے ہیں۔

stories.title: برطانوی حکومت کا تارکینِ وطن کے لیے مستقل سکونت کے قواعد سخت کرنے کا اعلان
stories.summary:
برطانوی حکومت نے انڈیفینیٹ لِیو ٹو ریمین یعنی مستقل سکونت کے قواعد میں نمایاں تبدیلیوں کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ نئے قوانین کے تحت اب زیادہ تر تارکینِ وطن کو برطانیہ میں مستقل سکونت کے حصول کے لیے پانچ سال کے بجائے دس سال تک قیام کرنا ہوگا۔ آئی ایل آر کی یہ حیثیت فرد کو ملک میں غیر معینہ مدت تک رہنے، کام کرنے اور تعلیم حاصل کرنے کا قانونی حق دیتی ہے، جبکہ شرائط پوری کرنے پر سرکاری مراعات اور شہریت کے لیے درخواست دینے کی راہ بھی ہموار کرتی ہے۔

گزشتہ سال نومبر میں وزیرِ داخلہ شبانه محمود نے اسکول، اسپتال اور دیگر شعبوں کے علاوہ عمومی تارکینِ وطن کے لیے اس مدت کو بڑھانے کی تجویز پیش کی تھی۔ بریگزٹ کے بعد برطانیہ آنے والے افراد کی تعداد میں ریکارڈ اضافے کے پیش نظر یہ اقدامات تجویز کیے گئے، تاکہ حکومتی اخراجات میں کمی لائی جا سکے۔ وزارتِ داخلہ کے تخمینے کے مطابق ان ترمیم شدہ منصوبوں سے سرکاری خزانے کو اربوں پاؤنڈز کی بچت ہو گی، اور اس سے متاثر ہونے والے افراد کی تعداد بھی سابقہ سات لاکھ ننانوے ہزار سے کم ہو کر پانچ لاکھ سترہ ہزار رہ جائے گی۔

تاہم حکومت نے کچھ مخصوص گروہوں کو اس دس سالہ نئے نظام سے مستثنیٰ قرار دیا ہے جو اب بھی پانچ سال بعد مستقل سکونت کے اہل ہوں گے۔ ان میں وہ افراد شامل ہیں جن کی آمدنی درخواست سے قبل کے پانچ برسوں میں سے کم از کم تین سال پچاس ہزار پاؤنڈ سالانہ سے زائد رہی ہو۔ اس کے علاوہ مئی 2025 سے قبل آنے والے کم از کم پچاس ہزار پاؤنڈ کمانے والے کیئر ورکرز، ڈاکٹرز، اساتذہ اور ہانگ کانگ سے تعلق رکھنے والے برٹش نیشنل اوورسیز اسٹیٹس کے حامل افراد بھی پانچ سالہ نظام کے تحت ہی درخواست دے سکیں گے۔

نئے نظام کے تحت درخواست گزاروں کو اپنی درخواست منظور ہونے سے پہلے سات برسوں میں سے کم از کم پانچ برس کے دوران سالانہ بارہ ہزار پانچ سو اکہتر پاؤنڈ کمانا لازمی ہوں گے۔ دوسری طرف پناہ گزین جو غیر قانونی راستوں سے برطانیہ پہنچے ہوں اور وہ تارکینِ وطن جو سرکاری مراعات یا بینیفٹس حاصل کرتے ہوں، انہیں مستقل سکونت کے لیے بیس سے تیس سال تک انتظار کرنا پڑ سکتا ہے۔ مجرمانہ ریکارڈ رکھنے والے افراد کو برطانیہ میں مستقل سکونت حاصل کرنے کی قطعی اجازت نہیں دی جائے گی۔

stories.title: Incomplete Police Report Clears Five Suspects of Sexual Assault in Lahore
stories.summary:
An incomplete investigation report filed before a trial court in Lahore has cleared five suspects of sexual assault charges related to the alleged July gang rape of two foreign women. The cleared individuals include a suspect reportedly linked to a senior government minister and another identified as a boss. However, the police report still implicates these five men in other offenses, including illegal detention and extortion. Conversely, the authorities formally charged three other suspects—alleged low-paid employees of a key suspect—with sexually assaulting the victims.

The case stems from an FIR registered under various provisions of the Pakistan Penal Code at Defence C police station. According to police findings, the complainants met one of the primary suspects in Singapore in 2025 and invited him to invest in a cryptocurrency business. After receiving initial returns, the investor provided an additional $500,000, which the women failed to return or generate profits on. In June, the suspect lured the foreign women to Pakistan under the guise of arranging another investment meeting. On June 29, the victims were taken to a house in Defence Phase VII, Lahore, where they were detained, threatened with weapons, and coerced into transferring approximately $19,500.

The women escaped on July 1 when a vehicle transporting them to the airport met with an accident near Bhatta Chowk, prompting them to raise an alarm. Police subsequently recovered Rs4.3 million in extorted funds, along with vehicles, mobile phones, and weapons. Although medical examinations and forensic procedures were conducted, the Punjab Forensic Science Agency reports are still pending. To avoid legal delays, investigators submitted the incomplete report, and Additional District and Sessions Judge Rafaqat Ali Gondal scheduled the next hearing for November 11 after distributing copies to the defendants.

stories.title: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Threatens Federal Minister With Defamation Notice
stories.summary:
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has announced her intention to issue a defamation notice to Federal Minister Chaudhry Salik Hussain following his remarks alleging widespread corruption within the Punjab government. Speaking publicly after watching the minister's interview on ARY News, Maryam Nawaz stated that she will not tolerate unfounded accusations and demanded that the federal minister substantiate his claims with concrete evidence rather than making generalized allegations.

The political fallout also touched upon administrative decisions and regional issues. Maryam Nawaz questioned whether Chaudhry Salik’s criticism stemmed from dissatisfaction over the recent transfer of the Deputy Commissioner of Gujrat. She recalled her own official visit to Gujrat, during which severe flooding submerged her Land Cruiser, and she criticized the federal minister's glowing assessment of former chief minister Pervez Elahi's previous provincial administration.

Beyond the specific corruption claims, Maryam Nawaz criticized the broader practice of federal ministers launching serious accusations without supporting documentation. She argued that individuals appointed to positions through personal recommendations often end up undermining the interests of the country and its citizens.

This sharp exchange highlights a growing political rift between the provincial leadership in Punjab and federal figures. The escalating war of words signals likely upcoming legal proceedings initiated by the Punjab chief minister as she moves to challenge the federal minister's statements in court.

stories.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia Explore Media Cooperation and Introducing Pakistani Dramas
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Minister for Information and Broadcasting, Attaullah Tarar, held a meeting in Islamabad with Saudi Ambassador Rajeh Tami Albugamy to discuss strengthening bilateral ties in media, culture, and people-to-people exchanges. A key focus of the discussion was introducing popular Pakistani dramas to Saudi Arabia. Tarar emphasized that these television productions effectively reflect traditional Eastern values, Islamic culture, and strong family structures.

During the meeting, Tarar highlighted that bilateral relations between Pakistan and Saudi Arabia continue to reach new heights, rooted in deep historical, religious, and generational bonds rather than purely diplomatic or political connections. He pointed to the Makkah Defence Agreement as a prominent symbol of strong defense cooperation between the two nations. Both dignitaries agreed to enhance collaboration across information, broadcasting, media, and cultural sectors.

To foster closer cultural ties, the information minister proposed reciprocal delegations comprising writers, poets, artists, musicians, media representatives, and digital content creators. Tarar also invited Saudi tourists, media professionals, and digital influencers to explore Pakistan's natural beauty and historical landmarks, positioning the country as an attractive tourism destination.

Additionally, both sides addressed the shared challenge of combating misinformation and negative propaganda by strengthening fact-checking mechanisms and producing culturally resonant content. Tarar proposed establishing a joint working group consisting of technical teams and focal persons from both countries to implement these cooperative objectives. The Saudi ambassador echoed these sentiments, expressing pride in the robust brotherly relations, mutual trust, and multifaceted cooperation between the two countries.

stories.title: Government and Jamaat-e-Islami Petroleum Levy Talks End Without Agreement
stories.summary:
A fresh round of discussions between government representatives and Jamaat-e-Islami concluded in Islamabad without making any progress regarding the petroleum development levy. According to sources familiar with the matter, the administration remains unwilling to eliminate the levy, maintaining that current petroleum prices are tied to rising international markets.

The meeting took place at the office of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar located within the foreign ministry. The official government negotiating team asserted that they have extended all possible financial relief to citizens concerning petroleum rates and continue to explore avenues for further assistance.

Representing the government side were Ishaq Dar, Ahsan Iqbal, and Rana Sanaullah. Meanwhile, the Jamaat-e-Islami delegation consisted of Liaquat Baloch, Sayed Farasat Shah, and Nasrullah Randhawa.

Following the inconclusive session, the Jamaat-e-Islami negotiating team convened internally to review the administration's firm stance. The delegation plans to brief Ameer Jamaat-e-Islami Hafiz Naeem ur Rehman regarding the comprehensive details of the discussions.

stories.title: Murder Case Registered After Man Found Dead Inside Car in Karachi
stories.summary:
Local authorities in Karachi have registered a murder case following the grim discovery of a man's body inside a parked vehicle along Mochko Edhi Graveyard Road. The First Information Report was lodged at the Mochko police station against unidentified assailants after a formal complaint was filed by the victim's brother, Tayyib Zafar.

According to the police report, the victim was identified as Saad Zafar, a married father of two and a resident of Shadman Town who worked for a private logistics firm in Mauripur. Tayyib Zafar stated that he rushed to the Civil Hospital mortuary after receiving an urgent phone call informing him that his elder brother had sustained gunshot wounds while commuting to work.

Senior Superintendent of Police Kemari established a special investigation team headed by local police superintendents, station house officers, and an IT in-charge to thoroughly examine the homicide. The Crime Scene Unit inspected the vehicle, which bore multiple bullet marks, and recovered two 9mm bullet casings alongside a 9mm pistol found directly in the deceased person's hand.

Investigators are actively exploring all potential angles surrounding the incident. The victim's body was transferred for legal formalities and a post-mortem examination while crime scene technicians and CCTV teams gather crucial physical evidence.

stories.title: Lucky Motor Corporation Announces Price Reductions for Kia Sportage L Variants
stories.summary:
Lucky Motor Corporation has implemented temporary price cuts reaching up to Rs800,000 on its hybrid Kia Sportage L variants, starting November 3. The promotional adjustments are designed to offer lower ex-factory rates for a limited duration under specific booking conditions.

Under the official notification, the 1.6T FWD HEV variant has experienced a price reduction of Rs700,000, bringing its new cost to Rs11.499 million compared to the previous Rs12.199 million. Additionally, the 1.6T AWD HEV variant was lowered by Rs800,000, moving its price from Rs13.299 million down to Rs12.499 million.

The company specified that these promotional rates apply exclusively to new orders registered within its dealer management system provided full payment is realized by November 30. Customers are instructed to issue all financial drafts directly to Lucky Motor Corporation under the designated customer name account.

Lucky Motor noted that the announced ex-factory rates do not include freight and insurance charges. Furthermore, any subsequent duties, taxes, or government-imposed charges introduced prior to delivery will remain the financial responsibility of the customer.

stories.title: Supreme Court Rules Women's Dignity is a Constitutional Obligation for Public Servants
stories.summary:
The Supreme Court of Pakistan declared that upholding a woman's dignity is a fundamental constitutional obligation rather than a matter of personal choice, dismissing an appeal from a former Intelligence Bureau cook. The ruling was delivered by a two-member bench comprising Justice Ayesha Malik and Justice Shahid Waheed, who authored the nine-page judgment upholding the compulsory retirement of petitioner Jawad Abbasi.

Abbasi had faced departmental disciplinary proceedings under the Civil Servants Rules after being accused of setting his wife on fire, alongside exhibiting short-tempered and unprofessional behavior that allegedly damaged the reputation of the agency. Although a lower criminal court previously acquitted him, the departmental inquiry established the charges, leading to penalties upheld by both the Federal Service Tribunal and administrative channels. His defense counsel argued that the domestic incident occurred outside official duties and that his wife had attempted suicide.

Rejecting these arguments, Justice Waheed emphasized that a civil servant's private conduct directly reflects upon their suitability for public office and institutional discipline. The court stated that domestic violence cannot be shielded behind closed doors as a private family affair, noting that severe acts like burning a spouse constitute grave public wrongs rather than isolated marital disputes. The judgment stressed that constitutional protections for life, human dignity, and women's rights apply fully inside every home.

Concluding the verdict, the bench underscored that public confidence in state institutions requires civil servants to respect the dignity of others. The court severely criticized attempts to evade accountability by framing violent assaults as suicide attempts, ruling that such behavior is completely unbecoming of a government employee.

stories.title: Six Family Members Fatally Shot Inside House in Hangu
stories.summary:
A violent shooting inside a residential property in the Sarokhel area of Hangu district has left six members of the same family dead. According to local law enforcement under the jurisdiction of the Doaba Police Station, the victims included the household head Noor Rehman, two adult women, and three young children. All six individuals lost their lives directly at the scene.

District Police Officer Salahuddin Kundi reported that preliminary findings point to Noor Rehman's nephew as the primary suspect in the attack. Investigators stated that the suspect is reportedly a drug addict. Authorities believe a domestic dispute arose because the head of the household frequently prohibited his nephew from bringing friends involved in narcotics use into the family home.

Following the fatal incident, the suspect managed to flee from the property. Local police quickly responded by taking custody of all six bodies and transferring them to Doaba Hospital to complete necessary legal and medical evaluations. Officials confirmed that law enforcement teams have initiated targeted raids in an effort to apprehend the fugitive suspect.

Investigators are currently examining every available aspect surrounding the event to definitively establish the exact sequence of events and the underlying motives. This tragic occurrence has deeply impacted the community in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, prompting ongoing police efforts to locate the suspect and bring clarity to the investigation.

stories.title: لاہور میں ٹرک کی ٹکر سے خاتون جاں بحق، متعدد دیگر مقامات پر مختلف نوعیت کے واقعات
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے مغل پورہ میں ٹرک کی ٹکر سے ایک خاتون جاں بحق اور دوسری زخمی ہو گئی۔ پولیس کے مطابق حادثے میں زخمی ہونے والی خاتون اور جاں بحق ہونے والی خاتون کی لاش کو اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

دوسری جانب گوجرانوالہ میں بھی ٹرک کی ٹکر کا ایک اور افسوسناک واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں موٹرسائیکل پر سوار ایک ہی خاندان کے 4 افراد جاں بحق اور ایک شخص زخمی ہو گیا۔ پولیس حکام کا بتانا ہے کہ اس حادثے میں ملوث ملزم کے زیرِ استعمال ٹرک کو بھی تحویل میں لے لیا گیا ہے۔

مختلف شہروں میں پیش آنے والے دیگر واقعات کے دوران، کراچی کے علاقے بلدیہ ٹاؤن میں ایدھی قبرستان روڈ پر ایک کھڑی کار سے نوجوان کی لاش برآمد ہوئی جس کے سر پر گولی کا زخم موجود تھا۔ دریں اثنا، عالمی ماحولیاتی ویب سائٹ کے مطابق فضا کی آلودگی کے حوالے سے لاہور میں ایئر کوالٹی انڈیکس 447 جبکہ ملتان میں 490 ریکارڈ کیا گیا ہے۔

ان تمام واقعات سے یہ ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ مختلف علاقوں میں ٹریفک حادثات، جرائم اور ماحولیاتی مسائل عوام کے لیے سنگین خطرات بن چکے ہیں، جن پر قابو پانے کے لیے متعلقہ اداروں کی جانب سے کارروائیاں جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: پیپلز پارٹی کا انتخابی اصلاحات کمیٹی میں شمولیت کی دعوت دینے کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
اپوزیشن لیڈر سینیٹ علامہ ناصر عباس نے انکشاف کیا ہے کہ پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کا ایک وفد اپوزیشن قائدین سے ملاقات کے لیے آیا تھا جس نے انہیں انتخابی اصلاحات کمیٹی میں شمولیت کی باضابطہ دعوت دی ہے۔ جیو نیوز سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے بتایا کہ پیپلز پارٹی کا اصرار تھا کہ اس اہم معاملے پر اپوزیشن کو بھی مل کر کام کرنا چاہیے اور اس کمیٹی کا حصہ بننا چاہیے۔

علامہ ناصر عباس نے مزید وضاحت کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس معاملے پر باہمی مشاورت کے بعد پیپلز پارٹی کو باضابطہ خط لکھا جائے گا، اور حکومت کو بھی ایک خط ارسال کیا جائے گا تاکہ انتخابی اصلاحات کے لیے باقاعدہ کمیٹی تشکیل دی جا سکے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ مجوزہ کمیٹی کی تشکیل اس انداز میں ہونی چاہیے جہاں حکومت اور اپوزیشن کے اراکین کی تعداد غیر متوازن نہ ہو اور حکومت کو اکثریت حاصل نہ ہو۔

یہ پیشرفت ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئی ہے جب ملک میں سیاسی جماعتیں اور پارلیمانی رہنما مختلف آئینی اور قانونی امور پر باہمی رابطے بڑھا رہے ہیں۔ اپوزیشن کی جانب سے انتخابی اصلاحات کے معاملے کو سنجیدگی سے اٹھایا جا رہا ہے تاکہ آئندہ کے انتخابی عمل کو زیادہ شفاف اور متفقہ بنایا جا سکے۔

اس ملاقات اور دعوت کے بعد سیاسی حلقوں میں یہ توقع کی جا رہی ہے کہ حکومت اور اپوزیشن کے درمیان انتخابی اصلاحات کے نکتے پر بات چیت کا ایک نیا سلسلہ شروع ہو سکتا ہے۔ تاہم اپوزیشن نے واضح کر دیا ہے کہ کمیٹی کے قواعد و ضوابط اور اراکین کی مساوی نمائندگی ان کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کی حامل ہو گی۔

stories.title: وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز کا وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک کو ہرجانے کا نوٹس
stories.summary:
وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے اٹک میں طلبہ سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک حسین کو صوبائی حکومت کی مبینہ کرپشن سے متعلق دعوے پر ہرجانے کا قانونی نوٹس بھیجنے کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں کہا کہ اگر چوہدری سالک کے پاس کرپشن کے کوئی ثبوت موجود ہیں تو وہ انہیں عوام اور عدالت کے سامنے پیش کریں ورنہ ان کے خلاف قانونی کارروائی کی جائے گی۔

تقریب سے خطاب کے دوران مریم نواز نے میرٹ کی اہمیت پر زور دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ سفارش پر آنے والے لوگ ملک اور قوم کا بیڑا غرق کرتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ وہ اس تقریب میں طلبہ کو لیپ ٹاپس اور اسکالرشپس دینے کے ساتھ ساتھ ان کی محنت کو ایک ماں کی حیثیت سے سراہنے آئی ہیں۔ انہوں نے ماضی کا ذکر کیے بغیر کہا کہ وہ صرف مسائل گنوانے کے بجائے ان کے عملی حل کے لیے دن رات کوشاں ہیں۔

وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب نے مزید کہا کہ پنجاب حکومت طلبہ کو لیپ ٹاپس، اسکالرشپس اور موٹر بائیکس فراہم کرنے والا واحد صوبہ ہے، جبکہ صوبے میں تعلیم کے معیار کو بلند کرنے کے لیے تین سو نواز شریف اسکولز آف ایمننس قائم کیے جا رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے خواتین کے لیے صوبے کو محفوظ بنانے اور سرکاری اسکولوں و اسپتالوں کے معیار میں بہتری لانے کے عزم کا بھی اظہار کیا۔

اس موقع پر انہوں نے ضلع اٹک میں ترقیاتی کاموں کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ گزشتہ دو سالوں کے دوران آٹھ سو پچاس کلومیٹر طویل سڑکیں تعمیر کی گئی ہیں اور گرین بسوں کا آغاز کیا گیا ہے تاکہ عوام کو بہتر سفری سہولیات میسر آ سکیں۔

stories.title: سیاسی تناؤ ختم ہونا چاہیے، وزیراعلیٰ اور اسپیکر کا غائب ہونا عجیب منطق ہے: بیرسٹر گوہر
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے چیئرمین بیرسٹر گوہر علی خان نے پشاور ہائی کورٹ کے باہر میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ یہ ایک عجیب منطق ہے کہ وزیراعلیٰ اور اسپیکر غائب ہیں۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ ملک میں سیاسی تناؤ مزید نہیں بڑھنا چاہیے اور تمام مسائل کا حل باہمی بات چیت کے ذریعے نکالا جانا چاہیے۔

بیرسٹر گوہر نے اس بات پر اطمینان کا اظہار کیا کہ عدالت نے معاملے کو لارجر بینچ کی تشکیل کے لیے چیف جسٹس کو بھجوا دیا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ ایسے فیصلے سامنے آنے چاہئیں جو سب کے لیے یکساں ہوں، کیونکہ انہوں نے صرف بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملاقات اور ان کے علاج کا مطالبہ کیا تھا جس پر عدالتی احکامات کے باوجود عملدرآمد نہیں کیا گیا۔

چیئرمین پی ٹی آئی نے مطالبہ کیا کہ اب سیاسی انتقام کا یہ سلسلہ بند کیا جانا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے قومی و صوبائی اسمبلی کے ارکان کے علاوہ بانی پی ٹی آئی کی بہنوں کو بھی فوری طور پر رہا کرنے کا پرزور مطالبہ کیا۔

اس موقع پر انہوں نے بیرسٹر سیف کے اس بیان کو بے بنیاد قرار دے کر مسترد کر دیا جس میں کہا گیا تھا کہ پیشکش کے باوجود بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملاقات نہیں کی گئی۔ بیرسٹر گوہر کا کہنا تھا کہ ان کی جماعت آج بھی ملاقات کی کوشش کر رہی ہے اور مذاکرات ہمیشہ سنجیدگی اور نیک نیت کے ساتھ ہونے چاہئیں، جبکہ پی ٹی آئی نے کبھی بھی مذاکرات کی مخالفت نہیں کی۔

stories.title: Contaminated Drinking Water Discovered Across 145 Chiniot Schools
stories.summary:
An alarming evaluation conducted across public educational institutions in the Punjab region has revealed that students in 145 government schools in the Chiniot district are receiving unsafe drinking water. The findings emerged following comprehensive water quality testing managed by the District Research Laboratory throughout the entire area.

District Research Officer Irshad Ahmed detailed that testing encompassed 451 schools across the district, with water samples from 145 institutions failing to meet established safety benchmarks. The affected locations consist of 36 high schools, 26 elementary schools, and 83 primary schools situated in diverse neighborhoods throughout the region.

The analytical process measured multiple parameters including water color, taste, pH levels, and Total Dissolved Solids. While a Total Dissolved Solids reading of up to 1,000 is typically deemed acceptable for consumption, the failing samples recorded levels exceeding 2,000. Officials warned that these elevated concentrations present severe health hazards to the attending students.

This widespread contamination issue highlights significant infrastructure concerns within local educational facilities. The disclosure by health and research officials brings urgent attention to the quality of basic amenities provided to children attending public schools in the district.

stories.title: HUBCO Schedules Local BYD Electric Vehicle Production for December
stories.summary:
The Hub Power Company plans to initiate local manufacturing of Chinese automotive manufacturer BYD vehicles in December 2026. Company management shared this timeline during an analyst briefing, indicating that the Sealion 6 plug-in hybrid electric vehicle will serve as the initial locally assembled model produced in Pakistan.

According to a report from Arif Habib Limited, the enterprise's electric mobility sector continues experiencing strong momentum, with cumulative BYD sales surpassing 10,000 units. First-quarter financial results for fiscal year 2027 showed a profit of approximately Rs1.5 billion, with HUBCO accounting for Rs780 million of that total. Management anticipates further acceleration in growth once completely knocked down production begins.

In addition to the Sealion 6, the company is reviewing further options, particularly focusing on higher-volume B and C segments, with additional models expected around the end of calendar year 2026. This initiative follows BYD's formal entry into the Pakistani passenger vehicle market in March 2024 through a partnership with Mega Conglomerate Pvt. Ltd via its subsidiary Hub Power Holdings and associated entity Mega Motor Company.

The manufacturing facility, situated near Karachi, is a collaborative venture between BYD and Mega Motor Company. The plant is engineered with an initial output capacity of 25,000 units annually operating on a double shift, and holds the potential to scale production up to 50,000 units per year.

stories.title: Sindh Government Launches Advanced Breeding Technology to Boost Livestock
stories.summary:
The Sindh government has implemented advanced reproductive technology to upgrade livestock genetics and boost provincial milk and meat output. Through a partnership between the Sindh Livestock Department and Fongrow, the province successfully executed its inaugural embryo transfer experiment at the Sindh Institute of Animal Science.

Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah offered his congratulations to the Livestock Department for reaching this milestone. Livestock Minister Muhammad Ali Malkani updated leadership on the initiative, explaining that modern scientific approaches will accelerate the enhancement of indigenous cattle lines. The chief minister noted that breeding timelines traditionally requiring approximately 30 years can now be condensed to just five years using these methods.

To drive the program forward, the provincial government ordered 132 embryos representing the Red Sindhi and Guziara cattle breeds. Private-sector farmers additionally requested 222 total embryos, including 90 of their own, reflecting strong confidence from agricultural investors in the scientific initiative.

Officials emphasized that the deployment of these scientific techniques aims to safeguard and elevate the genetic value of local livestock. The program is projected to generate new economic avenues for local farmers while significantly raising regional agricultural productivity.

stories.title: Two Policemen Killed in Gunman Attack During Anti-Polio Campaign
stories.summary:
Two police officers lost their lives and another sustained injuries when unidentified armed assailants opened fire on a security detail. The incident occurred in the Taman Zai area of Pindiali tehsil within the Mohmand district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The victims were part of a team deployed to protect health workers administering polio vaccines during a national immunisation drive.

Rescue 1122 identified the slain constables as Zahoor and Fazal Rabi, while the wounded officer, Constable Sabir, was transferred to a medical facility for treatment. President Asif Ali Zardari issued a strong condemnation of the violence, paying tribute to the fallen officers and offering condolences to their grieving families while wishing the injured constable a swift recovery.

The attack took place on Tuesday during the ongoing nationwide sub-national anti-polio campaign, scheduled from November 2 to 8 across 97 selected districts. The National Emergency Operations Centre reported that the broader initiative targets roughly 24 million children under the age of five, utilizing over 200,000 frontline health workers in a door-to-door effort.

On the first day of the drive, more than 6.683 million children were successfully vaccinated nationwide. This included over 2.5 million in Punjab, 1.9 million in Sindh, 1.3 million in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and more than 572,000 in Balochistan, alongside children reached in Islamabad, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Azad Jammu and Kashmir. Authorities continue to urge parents to safeguard their children against the incurable disease.

stories.title: Government Invites PTI to Join Proposed Electoral Reforms Committee
stories.summary:
The federal government has formally invited the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf to participate in a newly proposed parliamentary committee focused on electoral reforms. Federal Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry reached out to PTI Chief Whip Amir Dogar via a telephone call to discuss the formation of the body and request the opposition party's membership names.

During the conversation, Amir Dogar inquired about the proportional composition of the proposed parliamentary committee. In response, Tariq Fazal stated that party representation would mirror parliamentary strength, allocating 15 seats to the government and five seats to the opposition based on the seat ratio.

Challenging this allocation, the PTI leader questioned the efficacy of the opposition given such low representation and demanded a revision of the formula. He suggested adopting the representation structure used for the electoral reforms committee established back in 2013, adding that his party would respond formally after consulting its parliamentary leadership. Dogar also called for an investigation into the alleged theft of the PTI's mandate in past elections.

Tariq Fazal emphasized the need for prompt submissions from the opposition so that notification of the committee can proceed, noting that the Terms of Reference will be compiled afterward. Similar letters requesting committee members have already been sent to the chief whips of the PPP and MQM.

stories.title: ECP Issues Show-Cause Notice to MQM-P Over Internal Elections
stories.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan has issued a formal show-cause notice to the Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan after the political party failed to conduct its required intra-party elections. The electoral body highlighted that the party neglected to carry out these internal polls even though it had been granted an extension extending the deadline until October 15, 2026.

According to the commission, holding regular internal elections is a strict legal mandate for all political parties under the Elections Act 2017. Parties are legally obligated to submit a formal compliance certificate within one week following the conclusion of their intra-party polls.

The ECP has granted MQM-P a 14-day window to submit a formal response to the show-cause notice. The commission warned that a failure to reply or comply will trigger further legal actions against the party.

Most notably, the notice explicitly cautioned that MQM-P could be stripped of its designated election symbol if it continues to bypass the requirement for internal elections. Losing the symbol would effectively bar the party from participating under its banner in the upcoming general elections.

stories.title: Islamabad Court Grants Bail to Imaan Mazari and Husband
stories.summary:
An anti-terrorism court in Islamabad has approved bail for human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha. The couple faced charges related to allegedly blocking a road outside the National Press Club and engaging in a physical altercation with police officers.

ATC Judge Abual Hasnat Muhammad Zulqarnain delivered the ruling following arguments on the bail applications and the review of the case records produced by the police. During the hearing, the judge criticized the authorities for a delay in presenting the case files, noting he had previously considered issuing severe consequences for the tardiness, and stated he would examine the show-cause notice given to the police regarding the delay. The court finalized the bail release upon surety bonds of Rs5,000 for each applicant.

This legal proceeding follows a turbulent period of detention for the couple, who were initially arrested on January 23 following a protest outside the Islamabad High Court. Over the subsequent months, they faced multiple convictions and prison sentences across different courts, including a 10-year sentence in a security breach case and a 17-year sentence under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, both of which drew widespread domestic and international criticism.

Although the Supreme Court previously suspended their sentences and ordered their release in September pending appeal outcomes, the relief was short-lived as Islamabad police promptly re-arrested them regarding the Kohsar police station security breach case registered on March 22 of the previous year.

stories.title: Pakistani Rickshaw Drivers Struggle as LPG Prices Surge Due to Border Closures
stories.summary:
Auto-rickshaw drivers in Lahore, Pakistan, are facing severe financial hardship due to soaring liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices driven by the closure of two Iranian border crossings since October 17. The closures have halted imports that previously reached about 7,000 metric tons daily from Iran. Rashid Ali, a 33-year-old father of two who has driven a rickshaw for 13 years, now earns less than half of his previous $6.50 daily income, forcing his family to reduce their meals to twice a day.

According to Majeed Ghauri, chairman of the Awami Rickshaw Union, about 70 percent of their members' 43,000 auto-rickshaws and nearly 8,000 Qingqis run on LPG, which is widely utilized for cooking and heating. Traders reported that the price of a 12-kilogram cylinder jumped 56 percent to 7,000 Pakistani rupees within days of the border shutdowns. The Balochistan provincial government attributed the closure to security and smuggling concerns, whereas Iran's foreign ministry blamed technical issues and import paperwork changes.

Ali's daily struggles include paying 600 rupees to rent his rickshaw, filling his gas cylinder four or five times daily at 300 to 400 rupees each time, and covering 11,000 rupees in monthly rent. Meanwhile, passengers frequently resist paying higher fares, offering as low as 80 to 150 rupees for trips that should cost significantly more. Passenger Mohammad Ramzan noted he routinely walks away if drivers decline his lower fare offers.

The crisis unfolds against a backdrop of mounting national inflation, which reached 9.6 percent in October, alongside a central bank interest rate hike to 12 percent driven by rising energy and wheat costs. Petrol prices have also climbed, hitting a record 458 rupees a liter on April 3. Returning home midday, Ali intends to work late into the night to secure enough money to buy food for his young children.

stories.title: Pioneer Cement launches 31MW solar facility at Punjab plant
stories.summary:
Pioneer Cement Limited has successfully commissioned and energized a 28.265-megawatt solar power plant at its manufacturing site located in Chenki, Khushab district, Punjab. The listed cement manufacturer officially announced the development through a formal filing submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Tuesday.

The company subsequently expanded the project's capacity from 28.265 MW to 31 MW, with the additional capacity scheduled for full commissioning within the next month. Company officials noted that the renewable energy installation is expected to supply roughly 45% of the facility's annual electricity needs through environmentally sustainable means.

This corporate initiative is projected to cut power expenditures significantly, enhance operational efficiency, and support broader profitability and sustainability goals. The project aligns with a wider national trend among energy-intensive industries in Pakistan turning to alternative energy sources to cope with rising electricity tariffs and improve performance.

Pakistan's overall solar capacity has expanded dramatically, growing from 321 MW in 2021 to 4,124 MW by December 2024, alongside massive panel imports from China. While this solar boom benefits commercial enterprises, it has created financial difficulties for the national grid and distribution companies due to falling demand for traditional electricity.

stories.title: Millions view Rahul Gandhi as India's leader, but does he want the job?
stories.summary:
Opposition rallies in Delhi suggest that millions of Indians view Rahul Gandhi as the ideal candidate to address the nation's severe economic inequality and divisive political climate. Observers note his commitment to restoring the prestige of Indian democracy, though questions persist regarding his readiness to confront entrenched authoritarian forces compared to other vocal regional leaders.

Historical precedents within the Nehru-Gandhi family lineage raise doubts about whether Rahul Gandhi harbors any personal ambition for the prime minister's office. Jawaharlal Nehru frequently offered to resign during political crises, experienced severe mental fatigue, and actively sought out alternative leaders rather than promoting family succession. Subsequent family members, including Indira and Rajiv Gandhi, entered high office under tragic or reluctant circumstances, while Sonia Gandhi famously declined the premiership in 2004 to support Manmohan Singh.

The broader political landscape includes concerning international alliances, such as Narendra Modi's partnership with Benjamin Netanyahu, which critics argue undermines secular democracy through spyware acquisition and minority disenfranchisement. Meanwhile, the political prominence of the Nehru-Gandhi family places them in direct opposition to powerful domestic and foreign actors, exposing them to significant security risks.

Ultimately, Rahul Gandhi's upbringing and political principles may leave him vulnerable to the aggressive tactics of right-wing politics. Critics and analysts question if he has ever expressed genuine personal interest in leading the government, pointing instead to other progressive political figures who might be better suited to manage the intense pushback from a cornered regime.

stories.title: Asian Football Confederation Postpones 2027 Asian Cup Until December
stories.summary:
The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has announced the postponement of the 2027 Asian Cup from early 2027 to December of that year. The 24-team tournament, originally scheduled for January 7 to February 5, will now be held from December 23, 2027, to January 21, 2028. The decision follows recent security incidents in host nation Saudi Arabia, including a strike on Riyadh's international airport last month that killed at least 12 people and wounded over 300. Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi movement claimed responsibility for that attack and subsequently launched drones toward Dammam airport.

The tournament's organizing committee stated that the rescheduling was necessary due to exceptional regional circumstances, substantial logistical complexities, and travel disruptions. The new dates will be submitted to FIFA for formal approval. Yasser Al-Misehal, head of the local organizing committee, affirmed that Saudi Arabia was fully prepared to host as scheduled and will maintain its momentum to ensure a seamless event worthy of the kingdom's stature and the AFC.

Saudi Arabia, which has won the Asian Cup three times, has never previously hosted the continental competition. The event serves as an early rehearsal for hosting the 2034 World Cup, following heavy investments in sports through the country's Public Investment Fund. Regional security concerns and travel disruptions have also affected other Saudi sporting events, prompting the indefinite postponement of the Saudi International golf tournament, the cancellation of the Urban World Championships in cycling, and the rescheduling of the Six Kings Slam tennis tournament and FIFAe Finals 2026.

Despite these postponements, some sporting events in the kingdom continue as planned. Notably, boxer Saul "Canelo" Alvarez defeated Christian Mbilli in a world title bout held in Riyadh on Saturday. Organizers and officials remain focused on delivering a high-standard organizational experience when the football tournament commences in its new late-2027 window.

stories.title: Massachusetts prosecutors seek retrial for Lindsay Clancy in children's deaths
stories.summary:
Massachusetts prosecutors are moving forward with plans to retry Lindsay Clancy following a mistrial and hung jury in September. Clancy faces accusations of killing her three young children, Cora, Dawson, and Callan, inside their Duxbury residence. Before the new legal proceedings can formally commence, several crucial judicial rulings must be addressed by the court.

During a recent hearing in Plymouth Superior Court, Judge William Sullivan indicated that the retrial could potentially begin in March, with additional scheduling dates established for mid-November. The case currently remains subject to pending motions from both legal teams regarding trial logistics and proposed restrictions on public statements. The prosecution has not specified whether the retrial will involve altered murder charges.

The core of the defense, presented by attorney Kevin Reddington, asserts that the defendant is not guilty by reason of a mental defect. The defense maintains that Clancy was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis and the effects of excessive medication at the time of the events. Conversely, legal prosecutors argue that while Clancy may have experienced psychological distress, she understood her actions were wrong and had planned the killings in advance.

stories.title: King Charles Left Soaking Wet While Queen Camilla Stays Dry
stories.summary:
King Charles found himself caught in a heavy tropical rainstorm during a Caribbean tour stop in Saint George, Antigua. While the 77-year-old monarch was left completely exposed to the downpour, his wife, Queen Camilla, walked away sheltered beneath the only available umbrella. Local participants in the Antigua and Barbuda independence day parade did not flinch as the storm lashed the area.

During the incident, King Charles was spotted gesturing and turning around to seek assistance while getting thoroughly soaked. He was eventually provided with an umbrella and joked about the mishap with Prime Minister Gaston Browne, telling him in an Instagram video that he felt he was about to grow watercress on his suit. This public frustration follows a viral 2022 incident in Northern Ireland where a leaky pen stained his hand.

The royal couple's ongoing Caribbean tour has largely been defined by debates surrounding Britain's historical role in the slave trade. King Charles is scheduled to deliver a speech to Commonwealth leaders on Tuesday. Since ascending to the throne, he has expressed sorrow regarding the suffering caused by slavery, though he has stopped short of offering an official British apology.

The matter matters as it highlights the ongoing public scrutiny and media attention surrounding the British monarch's overseas engagements and personal reactions. It also coincides with sensitive diplomatic discussions regarding historical reparations and Commonwealth relations during the royal visit.

stories.title: Is Rahul Gandhi Interested in Leading India as Prime Minister?
stories.summary:
Millions of Indian citizens view Rahul Gandhi as the ideal political candidate to steer the country away from divisive politics and severe economic inequality. A massive opposition rally in Delhi recently highlighted widespread discontent with vote theft and poll rigging. While Gandhi has demonstrated the drive to support Indian democracy, questions remain regarding whether he possesses the combative approach required to confront entrenched fascism.

Historical genealogy and family precedents suggest that Rahul Gandhi may harbor no personal ambition for the prime ministerial role. His grandfather, Jawaharlal Nehru, famously offered to resign during political crises and never groomed his daughter, Indira Gandhi, to succeed him. Similarly, Sonia Gandhi famously opposed her husband Rajiv Gandhi's entry into politics and later stepped aside in 2004 to let Manmohan Singh serve as prime minister, instead establishing an advisory council for progressive policy.

The Gandhi family's outspoken stance on international issues, such as calling out the genocide in Gaza, has placed them in the crosshairs of both domestic and foreign interlopers. Meanwhile, the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party frequently accuses the family of deep political ambition. Observers note that Gandhi's politically correct upbringing might struggle against the harsh realities and ugliness of right-wing political pushback.

This debate matters because it addresses the future leadership of India's political opposition and the ongoing struggle for the nation's democratic integrity. Understanding the historical context of the Nehru-Gandhi family provides insight into modern Indian political dynamics and the personal motivations driving key opposition figures.

stories.title: Hina Javed's Family Rejects Re-Investigation, Demands Judicial Commission
stories.summary:
The family of the late Hina Javed has formally expressed a lack of trust in police investigations for the third time and rejected an offer to transfer the case to another district. Fahad Javed, the brother of the deceased woman, addressed a letter to the National Assembly Standing Committee on Interior, continuing the family's persistent demand for an independent judicial commission to probe the murder. Senior Superintendent of Police Saif Ullah had previously contacted the relatives to advise them to submit a formal application for a fresh investigation.

The 45-year-old victim was found dead in the bathroom of a residence at Askari Apartments in the Lalkurti area of Rawalpindi, under the jurisdiction of the Civil Lines Police Station. According to the first information report filed by her brother, Hina's hands were tied behind her back, a cloth was stuffed into her mouth, and a wire was wrapped around her neck. The family alleges she suffered severe torture and possible poisoning before her death, and that suspects attempted to frame the homicide as a suicide. Hina had married Faisal Asghar in November 2025, marking his second marriage.

Police have arrested Faisal Asghar, the son of retired Colonel Asghar Ali Fayyaz, along with a domestic worker named Zeeshan. However, the victim's family remains aggrieved because her father-in-law, also named in connection with the crime, has not yet been arrested. Legal teams are currently reviewing the family's fresh demands as authorities navigate the legal limitations surrounding repeated changes of investigation teams.

The case matters because it highlights deep-seated public concerns regarding domestic violence, accountability, and the transparency of law enforcement procedures in high-profile murder investigations. The family's ongoing demands underscore the broader challenges victims' relatives face in seeking justice through official channels in Pakistan.

stories.title: North Korea Denies Involvement in Massive $6.3 Billion Binance Heist
stories.summary:
North Korea has strongly rejected US allegations that it orchestrated a massive $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist on the Binance platform, dismissing the claims as absurd rhetoric. The FBI recently stated that Pyongyang was responsible for stealing over $6 billion in digital assets, prompting Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of leader Kim Jong Un, to declare that the accusations demonstrate continued US hostility. This comes as Binance works to stabilize operations and encourage customer deposits following substantial withdrawals.

Cybersecurity experts and blockchain analytics firms, including Chainalysis and Elliptic, maintain that North Korean hackers are major global crypto thieves who rely on illicit digital funds to finance the country's nuclear weapons and ballistic missile programs. Estimates suggest that North Korea has stolen $7.6 billion in cryptocurrency this year alone, with analysts noting that digital asset theft has become a vital economic lifeline for the regime amid international sanctions. The estimated Binance theft alone equals roughly a sixth of North Korea's total economic output for 2025.

In response to the security breach, Binance temporarily froze withdrawals before gradually reopening them for various assets. Despite net customer outflows amounting to approximately 3% of platform assets, overall user confidence has largely held up. The exchange also launched a community appreciation campaign featuring fee rebates and yield-generating incentives to encourage trading activity through November 21.

This dispute matters because it underscores escalating international tensions surrounding state-sponsored cybercrime and the funding of illicit weapons programs. It also highlights the growing financial vulnerabilities and resilience of major centralized cryptocurrency exchanges facing unprecedented security threats.

stories.title: Two Policemen Killed and One Injured in Attack on Polio Team Escort
stories.summary:
Two police officers lost their lives and another sustained injuries when unidentified armed attackers opened fire on their vehicle in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Mohmand district on Tuesday. The officers were en route to join a polio vaccination team for security duty during an ongoing immunization campaign. Headquarters Deputy Superintendent of Police Liaquat Ali confirmed that the violent incident occurred near the Hashim Kor police checkpost in the Dag Tamanzai area of Pindiali tehsil. The slain constables were identified as Zahoor Khan and Arbai Khan, while the wounded officer was named as Sepoy Sabir Khan.

In a separate development within the province, KP Governor Faisal Karim Kundi took official notice regarding reports of four polio workers being abducted in Tank district on Monday. Governor Kundi strongly condemned the abduction, labeling it regrettable and emphasizing that the government carries the responsibility of safeguarding immunization personnel. He stressed that targeting workers who protect children's health is entirely against humanity and national interests, directing local authorities to execute immediate and effective measures for their secure recovery.

These security breaches coincide with a sub-national polio vaccination drive launched across the country on Sunday, which aims to reach roughly 24 million children spread over 97 high-risk districts. Pakistan and neighboring Afghanistan remain the sole two nations globally where the poliovirus is still endemic.
